desc: Paper notes: your own note taken back from its balloon (TTYD_NOTES_TEST, no relay; Rogueport's harbour): Mario stands by his own note (blue), the notes' button (the game's L) opens it, and the balloon offers Take back and Close (no rating: it's yours), the arrow at Close; left then A takes it back: the balloon says so and offers Close alone, notes.txt forgets it, and once closed it is no longer drawn
log_must: ^\[notes\] drawn: .*opened t0; text 'Treasure here!'; text '\+1'; text 'yours'; text 'Take back'; arrow; text 'Close'
^\[notes\] drawn: .*opened t0; text 'Treasure here!'; text '\+1'; text 'yours'; arrow; text 'Take back'; text 'Close'
^\[notes\] test: take gor_00 t0: Your note is taken back\.$
^\[notes\] taking back t0: Your note is taken back\.$
^\[notes\] drawn: .*opened t0; text 'Treasure here!'; text '\+1'; text 'Your note is taken back\.'; arrow; text 'Close'
log_must_not: ^\[notes\] A by t0 was the game's
